readings.span: So “so much depends” may literally refer to the labor of a farm and the people and animals sustained by it.
But the poem is also about **attention**.
The form suggests that ordinary things can contain beauty and meaning when we really look at them.
The poem may also imply that much of life depends on humble, easily overlooked things: tools, labor, weather, food, and daily routines.
Its point is less a hidden message than the experience of seeing this everyday scene clearly.
